I've already rebooted it twice and run a speed test. Can we skip the basics?
Okay, so is it a line fault or not? I need a clear answer and an ETA.

turns.text: Hello, this is Daniel Reed from Tunis centre. I'm having some serious internet issues here and it's really frustrating. Can you check on that for me?
Then you'll shut your beach ass up right now.
Can we please stick to professional language? This has been going on since yesterday, my service is terrible and my router light keeps flashing red.
Look, I've already rebooted the box twice and ran a speed test. It's not improving at all. Can you send someone out to check it? This is ridiculous.
Frustration building here. If no one’s coming out, when can I expect my service back online? This has been going on for days and my work depends on this connection.
I'll direct a service back online soon, okay just fuck off.
I need to speak with someone who can actually help me right now. This is unacceptable.
